payload.message:
Refresh this worker's Linear OAuth token every run.

Work only with ~/orchestration/worker and its own ~/orchestration/worker/linear-token.json; never use another worker's token state. Do not modify ~/orchestration/tools/linear-token/refresh-linear-token.js or scheduler files.

Use restrictive permissions and load ~/orchestration/worker/.env in the shell. Read refresh_token privately from this worker's linear-token.json into a shell variable; never echo it. Run the helper with --token-file ~/orchestration/worker/linear-token.json and an explicit --refresh-token using that variable, redirecting both helper stdout and stderr away from captured output. The explicit argument is required to force rotation even while fresh.

Only if the helper succeeds, run a local Node script that reads linear-token.json and replaces only the value of exactly one LINEAR_OAUTH_TOKEN= line in ~/orchestration/worker/.env with access_token. Preserve every other .env line exactly; if there is not exactly one such line, fail without altering .env. Never print token values. Set .env and linear-token.json to mode 0600.

Validate privately that access_token and refresh_token are present and rotated, LINEAR_OAUTH_TOKEN matches access_token, and expires_at is about 24 hours ahead. Report only sanitized success/failure and non-sensitive expiry metadata. If any prerequisite or refresh fails, do not change .env.
